header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH, CIRCUIT COURT, LARKANA
Hearing ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Abdul Khalique Junejo, attorney for the petitioner, present in person.
Mr. Saeed Akbar Siyal, Assistant Advocate General.
On the previous date of hearing, the petitioner’s attorney
sought time on the ground that learned counsel for the petitioner had
gone to Karachi for medical treatment. Today, Mr. Mazhar Ali Bhutto,
advocate holding brief for Mr. Aamir Ali Sohoo, learned counsel for the
petitioner, has again sought time on the ground that Mr. Sohoo, though
present in Court earlier, left the premises upon receiving an urgent
telephone call from his home regarding his mother’s serious illness.
Be that as it may, learned counsel holding brief contends
body: that, in response to the advertisement issued for recruitment under the Teachers Recruitment Policy, 2012, the petitioner applied for the post of Primary School Teacher on the basis of domicile in Union Council Ahmedpur, District Jacobabad, and passed the test conducted by the National Testing Service (NTS); that only one vacancy was available in that Union Council; and that the names of two other candidates, belonging to Union Council Dasti and Dongar Mohalla City, were included in the merit list of Union Council Ahmedpur with a view to depriving the petitioner, who was shifted to Union Council Dasti. Learned Assistant Advocate General submits that only one post was available, which has been filled on merit, based on the marks obtained by the candidates as shown in the merit list.

Learned counsel holding brief, on the instructions of the petitioner’s attorney, who is present in Court, states that the petitioner intends to submit a representation to the Secretary, School Education & Literacy Department, Government of Sindh, regarding her grievance. Learned Assistant Advocate General states that, if such a representation is filed, it shall be decided strictly in accordance with the law, the rules and the relevant recruitment policy.

In view of the above statements, this petition is disposed of as follows. The petitioner may submit a representation, together with a copy of this order and the relevant documents, to the Secretary, School Education & Literacy Department, Government of Sindh (respondent No.2), within fifteen days of today. The Secretary shall decide the representation within two months of receipt, by a speaking order passed in accordance with law, the rules, and the recruitment policy applicable at the relevant time, after giving a reasonable opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and to any other person likely to be affected. It is clarified that this order does not express any opinion on the merits of the petitioner’s claim or on the question of delay, both of which shall be examined by the competent authority in accordance with law. It also does not confer on the petitioner any right to appointment. The office is directed to communicate a copy of this order to respondent No.2 for compliance.
